title: When an Old Goal No Longer Fits
short_teaser: Goals can become outdated as values, circumstances, knowledge, or capacity change.
story: Goals can become outdated as values, circumstances, knowledge, or capacity change. Continuing only because a goal was once important can turn commitment into captivity. Changing direction can be an act of integrity when the original reason no longer holds. Reflection turns experience into guidance. The goal is not to stay in the past, but to carry forward what the past can teach. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
